name: Water Bottle Manipulation & Drinking Procedure
description: Operator grasps bottle, opens cap, drinks water, closes cap, and puts down bottle on the surface.

0.name: IDLE
0.instruction: Procedure initialized. Please take the water bottle.

1.name: BOTTLE_TAKEN
1.instruction: Bottle grasped. Next step: Please open the bottle cap.

2.name: CAP_OPENED
2.instruction: Cap opened. Next step: Please drink water.

3.name: DRINKING
3.instruction: Drinking water. Next step: Please close the bottle cap.

4.name: CAP_CLOSED
4.instruction: Cap closed securely. Next step: Please put down the bottle.

5.name: COMPLETE
5.instruction: Bottle put down. Water drinking procedure successfully completed.

ERROR_SEQ.alert_tts: Warning: Wrong move! The bottle cap is still closed. Please open the cap before drinking.
ERROR_SEQ.recovery_prompt: Open the bottle cap before bringing the bottle to your mouth.

ERROR_SKIP.alert_tts: Warning: Incomplete move! The bottle cap is still open. Please close the cap before putting down the bottle.
ERROR_SKIP.recovery_prompt: Close and secure the bottle cap before placing the bottle on the table.

ERROR_PREMATURE_PUTDOWN.alert_tts: Warning: Incomplete procedure. Please complete drinking and close the cap before putting down the bottle.
ERROR_PREMATURE_PUTDOWN.recovery_prompt: Pick up the bottle and complete the remaining procedure steps.

STALL_TIMEOUT.alert_tts: Notice: Inactivity detected during bottle operation. Please proceed with the next step.
STALL_TIMEOUT.recovery_prompt: Continue with the active procedure step.

ERROR_REGRESSION.alert_tts: Warning: A completed step has been reverted. Please redo the step to continue.
